source_description: Eric Stansifer, 'Rootclaim covid-19 origins debate: Final decision', 2023-12-18, 83pp
synonymy_threshold_note: HippoRAG's default is 0.8, which is calibrated for GritLM/OpenAI embeddings. e5's cosine floor between unrelated entities is ~0.77 and its median ~0.84, so 0.8 marks ~94% of all entity pairs as synonyms and collapses the graph into a near-clique. Genuine synonyms in this corpus sit at >=0.96. Re-measure this if you change the embedding model.

chunking.boundary_rule: chunks never cross a section boundary
chunking.chunk_id_scheme: chunk-<md5(text)> — identical to HippoRAG's EmbeddingStore scheme, so data/chunks.json joins 1:1 onto passage nodes
